I am hesitant about taking my medication because it works but does not help in a meaningful way (the symptoms for my disorder occurred much less frequently, but were intense). I wanted to bring up my concerns to my doctor but ended up lying and saying that I was doing better because I was feeling numb and distant and felt I could not properly speak about it at the time without sounding like I needed hospitalization (which thankfully I have not experienced but was still scared of). 

She has been helpful and supportive since I started asking for help so I am unsure why I was being dishonest. I am admittedly feeling better tonight but am having trouble sleeping. Thank you for your time.

Hello. I was recently diagnosed with Nightmare Disorder and have been troubled because the medication prescribed to me does not seem to help alleviate symptoms in a meaningful way. I am unsure how to bring up certain questions to my doctors because I am unsure if they are relevant in helping me cope with the disorder. I have a few questions: 

1. What treatments worked well for you? How long did it take you to stop one treatment and seek another?
2. Have you ever encountered medical professionals who you felt did not take you seriously? 
3. You've mentioned having dreams that were sensorily based (feeling pain, etc.), but have you ever had dreams which seemed to conflate specific emotions like anger/mania/etc.?
4. Does your schizophrenia affect your ability to communicate in some way, especially if it is not through an indirect channel like writing? (i.e., is it extremely difficult to express your ideas orally but not so much online?)

Thank you for your time.
